portfolio.name: Hashan Perera
portfolio.summary: Software engineer with 3+ years of experience building, supporting, and deploying production applications across .NET, Angular, React, NestJS, MongoDB, SQL Server, and AWS.
about: I build software that connects thoughtful interfaces with dependable systems. Based in Horana, Sri Lanka, my work spans enterprise .NET applications, Angular and NestJS platforms, and mobile tools that work even when connectivity doesn’t.

Currently at IGT1 Lanka – Sitecore, I investigate production incidents, debug .NET applications, and deliver carefully validated fixes for global customers. Previously at DigitusTec, I led a three-engineer team and built full-stack business applications with SAP Business One integrations.

I care about clean architecture, secure APIs, and the details that make software reliable. I use AI-assisted tools for coding, debugging, refactoring, and testing, grounded in code review and engineering fundamentals.

overviewPoints: Investigate production incidents and identify root causes across Sitecore XP, .NET applications, and SQL Server.
Implement and validate code fixes to maintain stability for global enterprise customers.
experience.summary: Supporting production stability for enterprise Sitecore XP and .NET applications used by global customers.
highlights: Investigate incidents across application code, .NET assemblies, SQL Server data, configuration, and runtime behavior.
Implement and validate code-level fixes with a focus on regression risk and production stability.
Work within structured engineering, troubleshooting, and customer communication practices.

overviewPoints: Led a three-engineer team delivering the Meeting Minutes platform, owning Angular architecture, NestJS APIs, security, and CI/CD.
Built CRM and agricultural business modules, and contributed SAP B1 integrations for quality-control workflows.
experience.summary: Delivered full-stack enterprise platforms across Angular, NestJS, MongoDB, and AWS.
highlights: Led the Meeting Minutes platform for a three-engineer team, defining Angular architecture, project structure, CI/CD workflows, and code review practices.
Built meetings, tasks, and approvals modules; implemented Auth0 JWT authentication, RBAC, Docker deployment standards, and MongoDB query optimizations.
Delivered CRM workflows, contributed SAP B1 integrations for quality control, and built core CYOL agricultural management modules.

overviewPoints: Solely developed the offline-first Outgrower mobile app for agricultural teams in Zambia, enabling field access for 500+ users.
Built offline storage and synchronization with Flutter and Hive, plus a NestJS backend integrated with SAP B1.
